name: Real Engine & Native Format Integration
features: Native and bounded scientific format decoders
External scientific engine readiness and shell-free execution plans
Background parsing for files larger than 100 MB
Safe output checksums, execution logs and resource metadata
scientific_boundaries: BAM/CRAM indexed analysis requires SAMtools and matching reference data where applicable
Proprietary vendor RAW and multi-gigapixel WSI formats require licensed/vendor adapters or OpenSlide support
Specialist engines and databases are detected but not falsely reported as bundled or validated
Clinical, diagnostic and regulated interpretation requires independent validation and expert review
